data.name: A Feather of the Phoenix
data.desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card in your GY; return that target to the top of your Deck.

data.name: A Rival Appears!
data.desc: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Special Summon 1 monster from your hand that has the same Level as the selected monster.

data.name: Abaki
data.desc: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by battle, both players take 500 damage.

data.name: Abare Ushioni
data.desc: Once per turn, you can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If you call it wrong, you take 1000 damage.

data.name: Accumulated Fortune
data.desc: Activate only as Chain Link 4 or higher. Draw 2 cards. You cannot activate this card if multiple cards/effects with the same name are in that Chain.

data.name: Acid Rain
data.desc: Destroy all face-up Machine-Type monsters on the field.

data.name: Adhesive Explosive
data.desc: Before damage calculation, if this card was attacked by an opponent's monster and was in face-down Defense Position at the start of the Damage Step: Equip this card to the attacking monster. Then, during your opponent's next Standby Phase, destroy the monster this card is equipped to.

data.name: Alien Grey
data.desc: FLIP: Place 1 A-Counter on 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field. (If a monster with an A-Counter battles an "Alien" monster, it loses 300 ATK and DEF for each A-Counter during damage calculation only.) After this card has been flipped face-up, when it is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, draw 1 card.

data.name: Alien Hunter
data.desc: If this card destroys a monster with an A-Counter by battle, it can attack once again in a row.

data.name: Alien Infiltrator
data.desc: Once per turn, this card can move to an adjacent (horizontal) unoccupied Monster Card Zone. If no Spell, Trap or Monster Card on your opponent's side of the field is in the same column as this card, it can attack your opponent directly.

data.name: Alien Mars
data.desc: The effects of Effect Monsters with A-Counters are negated, except for "Alien Mars".

data.name: Alien Mother
data.desc: If this card destroys a monster with an A-Counter by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, Special Summon the destroyed monster to your side of the field at the end of the Battle Phase. When this card is removed from the field, all monsters that were Special Summoned by this card's effect are destroyed.

data.name: Alien Skull
data.desc: You can Tribute 1 face-up Level 3 or lower monster on your opponent's side of the field to Special Summon this card to your opponent's side of the field. If you Special Summon this monster this way, place 1 A-Counter on this card, and you cannot Normal Summon or Set the same turn. (If a monster with an A-Counter battles an "Alien" monster, it loses 300 ATK and DEF for each A-Counter during damage calculation only.)

data.name: Alien Warrior
data.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, place 2 A-Counters on the monster that destroyed it. (If a monster with an A-Counter battles an "Alien" monster, it loses 300 ATK and DEF for each A-Counter during damage calculation only.)

data.name: Allure Queen LV3
data.desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can select 1 Level 3 or lower monster on your opponent's side of the field and equip it to this card. (Only 1 card at a time can be equipped due to this effect.) If this card would be destroyed by battle, the equipped monster is destroyed instead. During your Standby Phase, by sending this card to the Graveyard while it's equipped due to its effect, Special Summon 1 "Allure Queen LV5" from your hand or Deck.

data.name: Allure Queen LV5
data.desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Allure Queen LV3", you can select 1 Level 5 or lower monster on your opponent's side of the field and equip it to this card. (Only 1 card at a time can be equipped due to this effect.) If this card would be destroyed by battle, the equipped monster is destroyed instead. During your Standby Phase, by sending this card to the Graveyard while it's equipped due to its effect, Special Summon 1 "Allure Queen LV7" from your hand or Deck.

data.name: Allure Queen LV7
data.desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Allure Queen LV5", you can select 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field and equip it to this card. (Only 1 card at a time can be equipped due to this effect.) If this card would be destroyed by battle, the equipped monster is destroyed instead.

data.name: Amazoness Chain Master
data.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can pay 1500 LP; look at your opponent's hand, then add 1 monster from their hand to your hand.

data.name: Ambulance Rescueroid
data.desc:
"Rescueroid" + "Ambulanceroid"
This monster cannot be Special Summoned except by Fusion Summon. Once per turn, when a monster on your side of the field is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon that monster in Defense Position.

data.name: Ambulanceroid
data.desc: When a "roid" monster is added from your Graveyard to your hand, you can Special Summon that monster.

data.name: Amphibious Bugroth
data.desc: "Ground Attacker Bugroth" + "Defender of the Sea"

data.name: Ancient Gear
data.desc: If you control an "Ancient Gear", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in face-up Attack Position.

data.name: Ancient Gear Beast
data.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Negate the effects of an opponent's monster destroyed by battle with this card (including in the Graveyard).

data.name: Ancient Gear Cannon
data.desc: You can Tribute this card; inflict 500 damage to your opponent, and if you do, neither player can activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase of this turn.

data.name: Ancient Gear Castle
data.desc: All "Ancient Gear" monsters gain 300 ATK. Each time a monster is Normal Summoned/Set, place 1 counter on this card. If you Tribute Summon an "Ancient Gear" monster face-up, you can Tribute this card instead, if the number of its counters is equal to or greater than the number of required Tribute(s).

data.name: Ancient Gear Drill
data.desc: If you control an "Ancient Gear" monster: Discard 1 card; Set 1 Spell Card directly from your Deck. This turn, that Spell Card cannot be activated.

data.name: Ancient Gear Factory
data.desc: Reveal 1 Level 5 or higher "Ancient Gear" monster from your hand, then banish a number of "Ancient Gear" monsters from your Graveyard, whose combined Levels are double the revealed monster's, and if you do, if you Normal Summon the revealed monster this turn, you must Normal Smmon it without Tributing.

data.name: Ancient Gear Golem
data.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

data.name: Ancient Gear Soldier
data.desc: If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

data.name: Ancient Lamp
data.desc: During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon "La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp" from your hand. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. Before damage calculation, if this card is being attacked by an opponent's monster, and was face-down at the start of the Damage Step: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls, except the attacking monster; the attacking monster attacks it instead, and you proceed to damage calculation.

data.name: Anteatereatingant
data.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending 2 Spell or Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard. You can destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.

data.name: Aqua Dragon
data.desc: "Fairy Dragon" + "Amazon of the Seas" + "Zone Eater"

data.name: Archfiend Marmot of Nefariousness
data.desc: An air marmot that has a nefarious horn and wings. It attacks by throwing acorns.

data.name: Archfiend of Gilfer
data.desc: When this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; equip that target with this card. That monster loses 500 ATK while equipped with this card.

data.name: Armed Changer
data.desc: Send 1 Equip Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard to activate this card. If the equipped monster destroys a monster by battle, the controller of this Equip Card can add 1 monster with ATK equal to or less than the equipped monster from their Graveyard to their hand.

data.name: Armed Dragon LV10
data.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Armed Dragon LV7". You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY; destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

data.name: Armed Samurai - Ben Kei
data.desc: For each Equip Card equipped to this card, it gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase.

data.name: Assault on GHQ
data.desc: Target 1 monster you control; destroy it, then send 2 cards from the top of your opponent's Deck to the GY.

data.name: Attack Reflector Unit
data.desc: Tribute 1 "Cyber Dragon". Special Summon 1 "Cyber Barrier Dragon" from your hand or Deck.

data.name: Aussa the Earth Charmer
data.desc: FLIP: While this card is face-up on the field, take control of 1 EARTH monster your opponent controls.

data.name: Avalanching Aussa
data.desc: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 EARTH monster (except this card) to Special Summon 1 EARTH monster from your hand. The monster Special Summoned by this effect is destroyed if "Avalanching Aussa" is removed from your side of the field.

data.name: B.E.S. Covered Core
data.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 2 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, at the end of the Damage Step toss a coin and call it. If you call it wrong, remove 1 counter. If this card battles without a counter, destroy it at the end of the Damage Step.

data.name: B.E.S. Crystal Core
data.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can change 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls to face-up Defense Position.

data.name: B.E.S. Tetran
data.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 counter on this card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

data.name: Babycerasaurus
data.desc: If this card is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Dinosaur-Type monster from your Deck.

data.name: Banisher of the Radiance
data.desc: Any card sent to the Graveyard is banished instead.

data.name: Barrier Statue of the Abyss
data.desc: No monsters can be Special Summoned, except for DARK monsters.

data.name: Barrier Statue of the Drought
data.desc: No monsters can be Special Summoned, except for EARTH monsters.

data.name: Barrier Statue of the Heavens
data.desc: No monsters can be Special Summoned, except for LIGHT monsters.

data.name: Barrier Statue of the Inferno
data.desc: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except FIRE monsters.

data.name: Barrier Statue of the Stormwinds
data.desc: No monsters can be Special Summoned, except for WIND monsters.

data.name: Barrier Statue of the Torrent
data.desc: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except WATER monsters.

data.name: Battery Charger
data.desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Special Summon 1 "Batteryman" monster from your Graveyard.

data.name: Batteryman AA
data.desc: If all "Batteryman AA"(s) you control are in Attack Position, this card gains 1000 ATK for each. If all "Batteryman AA"(s) you control are in Defense Position, this card gains 1000 DEF for each.

data.name: Batteryman C
data.desc: If all "Batteryman C"(s) you control are in Attack Position, all Machine-Type monsters you control gain 500 ATK for each "Batteryman C" you control. If all "Batteryman C"(s) you control are in Defense Position, all Machine-Type monsters you control gain 500 DEF for each "Batteryman C" you control.

data.name: Batteryman D
data.desc: Your opponent cannot select a Thunder-Type monster you control as an attack target (except "Batteryman D").

data.name: Beast Soul Swap
data.desc: Target 1 Beast-Type monster you control; return it to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Beast-Type monster from your hand with the same Level as the monster that was returned to the hand.

data.name: Beelze Frog
data.desc: This card gains 300 ATK for each "T.A.D.P.O.L.E." in your Graveyard.

data.name: Behegon
data.desc: With an enormous maw and massive teeth, this monstrosity is one dangerous and strange serpent from the deep.

data.name: Behemoth the King of All Animals
data.desc: This card can be Normal Summoned or Set with 1 Tribute. In that case, the original ATK of this card becomes 2000. When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can return from your Graveyard to the owner's hand a number of Beast-Type monsters equal to the number of Tributed monsters.

data.name: Beiige, Vanguard of Dark World
data.desc: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Special Summon it from the Graveyard.

data.name: Big Evolution Pill
data.desc: After this card's activation, it remains on the field, but destroy it during your opponent's 3rd End Phase. Tribute 1 Dinosaur-Type monster to activate this card; while this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon Level 5 or higher Dinosaur-Type monsters without Tributing.

data.name: Big-Tusked Mammoth
data.desc: Monsters your opponent controls cannot attack the turn they are Summoned.

data.name: Bitelon
data.desc: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

data.name: Black Horn of Heaven
data.desc: When your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster: Negate the Special Summon, and if you do, destroy it.

data.name: Black Ptera
data.desc: If this card is sent from the field to the GY, except by being destroyed by battle: Return it to the hand.

data.name: Black Stego
data.desc: If this Attack Position card is targeted for an attack: Change this card to Defense Position.

data.name: Blade Rabbit
data.desc: When this card is changed from Attack Position to face-up Defense Position, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

data.name: Blade Skater
data.desc: An image of beauty on the ice, this gorgeous warrior rips her opponents into pieces with her stylish Accel Slicer attack.

data.name: Blast Asmodian
data.desc: If any Spell or Trap Card(s) are Chained, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

data.name: Blast Magician
data.desc: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. You can remove any number of Spell Counters from this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field with ATK less than or equal to the number of counters you removed x 700; destroy that target.

data.name: Blasting Fuse
data.desc: Activate only when all zones of this card's column are occupied. Destroy all cards in this column.

data.name: Blazing Hiita
data.desc: Once per turn, you can Tribute 1 FIRE monster (except this card) to Special Summon 1 FIRE monster from your hand. The monster Special Summoned by this effect is destroyed if "Blazing Hiita" is removed from your side of the field.

data.name: Blocker
data.desc: Constructed from several components, this monster can launch them in a pincer attack.

data.name: Blockman
data.desc: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon in Defense Position, a number of "Block Tokens" (Rock-Type/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1500) equal to the number of your turns this card has been face-up on your field. These Tokens cannot declare an attack.

data.name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon
data.desc: "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"

data.name: Bonding - H2O
data.desc: Tribute 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon"; Special Summon 1 "Water Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

data.name: Boss Rush
data.desc: You cannot Normal Summon or Set. During the End Phase of the turn that a "B.E.S." monster or a "Big Core" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "B.E.S." monster or 1 "Big Core" from your Deck.

data.name: Bountiful Artemis
data.desc: Each time a Counter Trap Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, draw 1 card.

data.name: Brain Control
data.desc: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that can be Normal Summoned/Set; take control of that target until the End Phase.

data.name: Brain Jacker
data.desc: FLIP: Equip this card to a monster on your opponent's side of the field and treat it as an Equip Card. Take control of the equipped monster. Your opponent gains 500 Life Points during each of their Standby Phases.

data.name: Brainwashing Beam
data.desc: Select 1 monster with at least 1 A-Counter on your opponent's side of the field and take control of that monster. During each of your End Phases, remove 1 A-Counter from that controlled monster. If all A-Counters are removed from that monster, or that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

data.name: Branch!
data.desc: When a Fusion Monster(s) on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 of the Fusion Materials in your Graveyard that was used for its Fusion Summon; Special Summon it.

data.name: Breath of Light
data.desc: Destroy all face-up Rock-Type monsters on the field.

data.name: Broww, Huntsman of Dark World
data.desc: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Draw 1 card, plus another card if this card was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect.

data.name: Brron, Mad King of Dark World
data.desc: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can discard 1 card.

data.name: Bubble Blaster
data.desc: You can only equip this card to "Elemental Hero Bubbleman". Increase the ATK of the equipped monster by 800 points. If the equipped monster would be destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead, and make the Battle Damage to the controller of the equipped monster 0.

data.name: Bubble Illusion
data.desc: You can only activate this card while there is a face-up "Elemental Hero Bubbleman" on your side of the field. During this turn, you can activate 1 Trap Card from your hand.

data.name: Bubble Shuffle
data.desc: Target 1 face-up Attack Position "Elemental HERO Bubbleman" you control and 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; change both those targets to Defense Position, then Tribute that "Elemental HERO Bubbleman", then Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your hand.

data.name: Burglar
data.desc: A sly rat. He will come at you with his huge left claw.

data.name: Burst Return
data.desc: If you control a face-up "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix": Return all face-up "Elemental HERO" monsters on the field to the hand, except "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix".

data.name: Byroad Sacrifice
data.desc: Activate only if a monster on your side of the field is destroyed by battle. Special Summon 1 "Cyber Ogre" from your hand.

data.name: Canyon
data.desc: If a Rock-Type monster in Defense Position is attacked, double any Battle Damage to the controller of the attacking monster.

data.name: Catnipped Kitty
data.desc: This card cannot be attacked if there is another Beast-Type monster on your side of the field. Once per turn, you can make the DEF of 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field 0 until the end of this turn.

data.name: Celestial Transformation
data.desc: Special Summon 1 Fairy monster from your hand. That monster's ATK is halved, also it is destroyed during the End Phase.

data.name: Centrifugal Field
data.desc: When a Fusion Monster(s) is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Its owner targets 1 Fusion Material Monster in their Graveyard that is listed on that Fusion Monster; that player Special Summons that target.

data.name: Chain Detonation
data.desc: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. If this card was activated as Chain Link 2 or 3, add this card to the Deck and shuffle it. If this card was activated as Chain Link 4 or higher, return this card to the hand.

data.name: Chain Healing
data.desc: Gain 500 Life Points. If this card was activated as Chain Link 2 or 3, add this card to the Deck and shuffle it. If this card was activated as Chain Link 4 or higher, return this card to the hand.

data.name: Chain Strike
data.desc: Activate only as Chain Link 2 or higher; inflict 400 damage to your opponent times the Chain Link number of this card. You cannot activate this card if multiple cards/effects with the same name are in that Chain.

data.name: Chain Thrasher
data.desc: This card can attack 1 additional time during the same Battle Phase for each "Chain Thrasher" in your Graveyard.

data.name: Chainsaw Insect
data.desc: At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked or was attacked: Your opponent draws 1 card.

data.name: Chimeratech Overdragon
data.desc:
"Cyber Dragon" + 1+ Machine monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Fusion Summoned: Send all other cards you control to the GY. The original ATK/DEF of this card each become equal to the number of Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon x 800. Each turn, this card can attack your opponent's monsters a number of times equal to the number of Fusion Materials used for its Fusion Summon.

data.name: Chiron the Mage
data.desc: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell Card, then target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

data.name: Chrysalis Dolphin
data.desc: By Tributing this card while "Neo Space" is on the field, Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin" from your hand or Deck.

data.name: Chthonian Alliance
data.desc: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK for each other face-up monster on the field that has the same name it does.

data.name: Chthonian Blast
data.desc: When a face-up monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy the 1 face-up monster on the field that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied), and if you do, inflict damage to both players equal to half of that monster's ATK.

data.name: Chthonian Polymer
data.desc: Activate only when your opponent Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster. Tribute 1 monster to take control of that Fusion Monster.

data.name: Chthonian Soldier
data.desc: When this card is destroyed by an opponent's attacking monster and sent to the Graveyard, the Battle Damage you took from this battle is also inflicted to your opponent.

data.name: Chu-Ske the Mouse Fighter
data.desc: A fiery mouse, travelling the world to become the strongest fighter in the world of mice. Be careful not to touch him, or you will get burned.

data.name: Clay Charge
data.desc: When an "Elemental HERO Clayman" you control is targeted for an attack (even if it is face-down, but reveal it to your opponent in that case): Destroy the attacking monster and that "Elemental HERO Clayman", and inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

data.name: Clock Tower Prison
data.desc: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: Place 1 Clock Counter on this card. While there are 4 or more Clock Counters on this card, you do not take any battle damage. If this card with 4 or more Clock Counters is destroyed and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO - Dreadmaster" from your hand or Deck.

data.name: Clown Zombie
data.desc: A clown revived by the powers of darkness. Its deadly dance has sent many monsters to their graves.

data.name: Combo Fighter
data.desc: If a Chain (of 2 or more Links) occurred in your Main Phase 1, this card can attack twice during the Battle Phase this turn.

data.name: Combo Master
data.desc: If a Chain (of 2 or more Links) occurred in your Main Phase 1, this card can attack twice during the Battle Phase this turn.

data.name: Common Soul
data.desc: Select 1 face-up monster on the field. Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster from your hand to the same side of the field as the selected monster. The selected monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the monster that was Special Summoned by this effect. When this card is removed from the field, return the Special Summoned monster to its owner's hand.

data.name: Conscription
data.desc: Excavate the top card of your opponent's Deck, and if it is a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, Special Summon it to your field. Otherwise, add that card to your opponent's hand.

data.name: Contact
data.desc: Send all "Chrysalis" monsters you control to the Graveyard, and Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck that is written in the card text of those cards.

data.name: Corruption Cell "A"
data.desc: Place 1 A-Counter on 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field.

data.name: Cosmic Horror Gangi'el
data.desc: If you're Tributing a monster on your side of the field that is owned by your opponent, this card can be Normal Summoned with 1 Tribute. Once per turn, you can place 1 A-Counter on a monster on your opponent's side of the field. (If a monster with an A-Counter battles an "Alien" monster, it loses 300 ATK and DEF for each A-Counter during damage calculation only.)

data.name: Counter Cleaner
data.desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Remove all counters from the field.

data.name: Criosphinx
data.desc: When a monster is returned from the field to the owner's hand, the owner of the returned monster selects and sends 1 card in their hand to the Graveyard.

data.name: Crop Circles
data.desc: Send any number of monsters from your side of the field to the Graveyard to activate this card. Select from your Deck 1 "Alien" monster whose Level is equal to the total Levels of the sent monsters, and Special Summon it. If you fail to find a monster to Special Summon, you take 2000 damage.

data.name: Cross Counter
data.desc: If the DEF of an attacked Defense Position monster is higher than the ATK of your opponent's attacking monster, the Battle Damage inflicted to your opponent is doubled. Destroy the attacking monster after damage calculation.

data.name: Cyber Archfiend
data.desc: At the beginning of your Draw Phase, if you have no cards in your hand, draw 1 more card in addition to your normal draw. During your End Phase, if you have 1 or more card(s) in your hand, destroy this card.

data.name: Cyber Barrier Dragon
data.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Attack Reflector Unit". Once per turn, while this card is in Attack Position, your opponent's next attack is negated.

data.name: Cyber Blader
data.desc:
"Etoile Cyber" + "Blade Skater"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. While your opponent controls only 1 monster, this card cannot be destroyed by battle. While your opponent controls only 2 monsters, double this card's ATK. While your opponent controls only 3 monsters, negate the effects of your opponent's Spell, Trap, and Effect Monster Cards.

data.name: Cyber Dragon
data.desc: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

data.name: Cyber End Dragon
data.desc:
"Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon" + "Cyber Dragon"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

data.name: Cyber Esper
data.desc: While this card is in face-up Attack Position, you can look at every card your opponent draws.

data.name: Cyber Gymnast
data.desc: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

data.name: Cyber Harpie Lady
data.desc: (This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)

data.name: Cyber Kirin
data.desc: You can Tribute this card to make any effect damage you take this turn 0.

data.name: Cyber Laser Dragon
data.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Photon Generator Unit". Once per turn, you can destroy 1 monster with ATK or DEF equal to or higher than the ATK of this card.

data.name: Cyber Ogre
data.desc: By discarding this card from your hand to the Graveyard, negate 1 battle involving a "Cyber Ogre" on your side of the field, and it gains 2000 ATK until the end of its next battle. This effect can be activated during either player's turn.

data.name: Cyber Ogre 2
data.desc:
"Cyber Ogre" + "Cyber Ogre"
A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. When this card attacks, it gains ATK equal to half the ATK of the attack target, during damage calculation only.

data.name: Cyber Phoenix
data.desc: While this card is in Attack Position, negate any Spell/Trap effects that target 1 Machine monster you control (and no other cards). When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can draw 1 card.

data.name: Cyber Prima
